title: Ulyana and the Ghost
author: Petra Coldharbour
blurb: Zephyrine Zhou, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
